title: ARCHIVE FRAGMENT / 01
asset_strategy: Lead with the raw painting and reconstruction assets, then move into studio/process evidence, and finish with a strong worn product hero from the JRR shoot set. Keep the sequence legible: canvas, capture, reconstruct, wear.

slides.headline: ONE PAINTING
slides.notes: Use the painting as the dominant field. Bone background, minimal crop, high tension, archive-first.

slides.headline: EXTRACTED ZONE
slides.notes: Show the digital reconstruction as evidence, with coordinate logic and optical scan feel.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCTED
slides.notes: Frame the design file like a technical archive plate. Sparse, sharp, controlled.

slides.headline: PLACED ON BODY
slides.notes: Use process/studio evidence to show the fragment moving from screen to garment. Keep it tactile.

slides.headline: WORN
slides.notes: Strong hero frame. Oversized silhouette, movement, premium streetwear confidence, concrete/shadow context.

slides.headline: SYSTEM END
slides.notes: Closing card with negative space and protocol energy. Feels like a quiet end-state, not a promo.

caption:
One painting.
Extracted.
Reconstructed.
Worn.

The source remains.

image_concepts.name: canvas to body hero
image_concepts.brief: Show the full transformation in one premium campaign image: raw painting influence projected into a wearable oversized garment on a moving body.
